description: This file defines a utility enum 'GatewayEndpointID' with static methods for generating stable IDs and pretty descriptions of network endpoints, mainly utilizing the Network framework's NWEndpoint type.

methods.name: stableID
methods.description: Generates a stable string identifier for a given NWEndpoint, normalizing service names to ensure consistency.

methods.name: prettyDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of an NWEndpoint.

methods.name: normalizeServiceNameForID
methods.description: Decodes and trims whitespace from a service name to produce a normalized string for identifiers.
